acs.text: Valid codes apply the discount to the total
acs.clarified_as: SAVE10 = 10% off; FLAT20 = $20 off orders of $50+. Case-insensitive. One code at a time; a new code replaces the old. $120 cart: SAVE10 → $108.00, FLAT20 → $100.00. (Q-1, Q-6, Q-AI-2, Q-AI-3, Q-AI-4)

checks.description: API: SAVE10 and FLAT20 return the right discount and total for a $120 cart
UI: applying SAVE10 shows the discount line and total $108.00; applying FLAT20 next replaces it with total $100.00

acs.clarified_as: Unknown codes, expired codes (WELCOME5) and FLAT20 under $50 are refused with a message under the field; total unchanged. FLAT20 message states $50. (Q-2, Q-AI-1, Q-AI-3)

checks.description: API: unknown and expired codes return 400 with an error message
API: FLAT20 under $50 is refused with a message that names $50 (rule tested directly against discount logic)
UI: an unknown code shows an alert and the total stays $120.00
